subject: Re: Status: benchmark repro done; where GIFT wins and where it doesn't
body:
Katya, Ivo,

Decision from yesterday's review: we go forward with the GIFT-on-top-of-DA config for the pilot, scoped to one customer pipeline, and we publish the cost-vs-shift table as part of the offering rather than hiding it. The +2.3 point delta without intermediate data is the sales story; the 5x worst-case cost is the fine print, and I would rather put it in the contract than in an apology later.

Scope cut: the auto-scheduling idea (detect drift, trigger adaptation automatically) is out for this window. It is a Q3 OKR candidate but it needs the corpus snapshot tooling to mature first.

Ivo - please have the pilot snapshot cut by 6/19 so we are clean of the freeze. Katya - two-slide summary for my portfolio review on 6/18, numbers only, no adjectives.

Dmitri
